lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; the reply always asks New York's item C question; the project takes a federal Yes to sa.dependent and asks the New York question only after a federal No (ny_it201.item_c_if_not_federal). A federal Yes ('Can someone claim you or your spouse as a dependent', which excludes a claimant who need not file) implies New York's broader Yes ('If you can be claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's federal return, you must mark an X in the Yes box', IT-201-I p. 5, Item C; 'even if the other taxpayer did not claim you'), so the two agree whenever the filer answers consistently. Triage b7f692226401: 2,845/2,883 agree; 6 value differences, all on refused returns, and 32 candidate-unknown, every one because the interview does not ask ny_it201.ask.item_c after a federal Yes. Owner decision B8; amb.ny.2025.item_c.

Ruling: interface gap; the reviewer was not given the federal dependent fields (dependent.claimed, dependent.one), which the New York text never names, and encoded zero. The project counts the dependents for whom dependent.claimed is true, the federal qualifying-child and qualifying-relative tests, which is the class item H lists: IT-201-I p. 6, Item H, "Enter the required information for each dependent you claimed on federal Form 1040. Also enter the required information for any dependent you were entitled to claim on your federal return but chose not to". No New York fact reads differently; not a defect.

Ruling: interface gap; project retained. IT-201 p. 2, line 11, "Rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts, etc. (submit copy of federal Schedule E, Form 1040)", is the label of federal Schedule 1 line 5, and IT-201-I p. 7, Lines 1 through 19, "The calculation of your New York State, New York City, and Yonkers income tax is based on the information you reported on your federal income tax return". The request's federal catalog did not offer s1.line5 (the label rule credits "federal" only before the phrase; here it follows), so the reply entered 0 and itself notes "The real figure must come from a federal Schedule 1 line 5 interface once one is supplied." Tool gap recorded as BUG-1219.

Ruling: interface gap; project retained. IT-201 p. 2, line 12, "Rental real estate included in line 11", is the rental real estate part of line 11, which is federal Schedule 1 line 5 (Schedule E line 41 when the return has rental or royalty property). The request's federal catalog offered no Schedule E interface, so the reply entered 0 and itself notes that the line needs a source; the project takes Schedule E line 41 less its royalties (Parts II to V are refused federally: scope.k1, scope.remic, scope.farm). Same tool gap as line 11, BUG-1219.
